title: Erdős-Hajnal Conjecture
exact_target: For each fixed forbidden induced graph, must every graph avoiding it contain a clique or independent set whose size grows as a positive power of the number of vertices?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1418 (GRAPH-031). CC BY 4.0.
Shenwei Huang, Yiao Ju and Yidong Zhou, Erdős–Hajnal Conjecture Beyond Five-Vertex Graphs, arXiv:2606.06258v3 (2026), Section 1, Conjecture 1, pages 1--2.
